task/tests/test.sh (single app process + single DB for gates then scored, rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1)
v15 hosted verifier reward.json x3 (hashes 03bb313a..., f9ca6b6c..., 44a54ee5... re-verified LF-normalised) and reward-details.json for Oracle kTaeUNx and GPT RUAQ5Z4
evidence: test.sh starts one app process on one DB and runs gates (render, constraints) then scored (functional, polish, visual) sequentially against it, so every later dimension sees records created earlier (constraints judge.toml:32 saves a snippet; functional saves many and calls the single-use restart_app). The seed is empty (seed_data.json snippets: []), and no criterion asserts a pristine or empty library, a record count, a revision number of a pre-existing record or a starting draft: every library/history criterion creates its own snippet with a unique title and reasons relative to what it observed (functional 344 'same single record with the same current revision... noted before the restart'; polish 50/59 save their own snippet), and app_context.md:26 states 'the library may already hold records from earlier checks. Do not assume an empty library and do not delete records that earlier checks created'; app_context.md:25 says use fresh scratch drafts and :30 says open fresh pages after restart. Browser state does not leak between dimensions (playwright-mcp '--isolated' in every judge.toml:12), and the restart tool is offered only in functional and marked single use (restart_mcp.py:18), so polish/visual are not affected by its use. Adversarial: a broken app that only works on an empty library gains nothing, since criteria grade per-record behaviour; a conforming app with a long, scrolling library is not penalised because no criterion counts entries. Residual P3 only: visual cw_visual_workspace_layout will see a library populated by ~15-20 earlier records, which is legitimate observable state, and the v15 Oracle scored it 5/5 with 'snippet cards wrap neatly into two rows'. Runtime: v15 hosted runs (same golden, different criteria text) show Oracle polish 1.0 and visual 1.0 after gates/functional mutated the shared DB; no configured judge run exists on these v16 bytes, so this row is source-reviewed and v15-corroborated only (the full-verifier runtime gap is owned by the pipeline's runtime records, not waived here).
